title: Anchor-corpus stewardship and config-change watcher for eval regression gating
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a hardened ‘anchor corpus’ (immutable reference prompt/ground-truth set) plus an automated change-watcher that ties config and model changes to eval regressions. The goal is to provide a trustworthy, auditable source-of-truth used by CI, rollout gates, and on-call alerts so that any model or config rollout that causes measurable quality degradation is automatically flagged and (optionally) gated. This ticket scopes corpus stewardship policies, signed snapshot manifests, ACLs for updates, versioning semantics, and the watch service that computes differential deltas when runtime config/model variants are introduced.
background: Repeated incidents in Q4 2025 where config tweaks (batching, kv-cache policy) caused subtle regressions surfaced the need for immutable anchors that CI and the console can rely on. Existing ‘golden’ flows are fragmented across teams and lack strict signing, retention rules, or a change-watcher integrated with rollout policies. We need a single, ops-friendly pattern that engineering, product, and design can adopt.
acceptance_criteria: Anchor corpus stored as versioned, signed snapshots accessible via reference URI
Update workflow requires a signed change PR + two-steward approvals (PM + ML engineer) to publish a new anchor snapshot
Change-watcher detects regressions for any model/config delta and reports to Grafana alert with contextual diff and failing prompt IDs
Rollout gating integration: a failing regression alert can mark a rollout as blocked in the Console until triage
ACLs enforced: only steward role can promote draft anchor snapshots to production; read access permitted to eval CI and readonly roles
Retention policy and immutability: published snapshots are immutable for 180 days and retain provenance metadata (creator, commit SHA, signed manifest)
decisions: Use signed manifest schema v2 to record snapshot metadata (sha256 of bundle, creator, steward approvals, related PR/commit)
Store anchor snapshots in S3-compatible storage with object-lock semantics for immutability
Implement change-watcher as a serverless pipeline that subscribes to model/config change events and triggers staged eval runs using the anchor corpus
Thresholds: use 95% CI on metric deltas; initial alert threshold set to 2% absolute drop on primary metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/LLR/Task-specific) with per-prompt heatmap
Fail-open behavior: watcher will not auto-rollback; it will create an incident and optionally annotate rollout status; auto-rollback is deferred pending legal/ops approval (future follow-up)

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Publishing stale anchors that don't represent production traffic distribution. Mitigation: enforce a traffic-representative sampling step in the stewarding checklist and add coverage metrics to manifests.
Risk: Alert fatigue from small metric fluctuations. Mitigation: implement multi-window aggregation, per-prompt bucketing, and allow teams to customize thresholds per project.
Risk: Unauthorized snapshot updates. Mitigation: require signed manifests, two-steward approvals, and object-lock in storage with retention policy.
